package.name: occlusion_boundary
package.description:
Sensor-independent occlusion-boundary extraction from a ROG-Map occupancy grid.
Detects, in map space, the voxels through which an unseen agent could emerge -- the 3D analogue of a 2D range-jump occlusion corner, but without needing any beam-grid adjacency, so it works with non-repetitive scanners (Livox Avia / Mid-360) as well as beam lidars (VLP-32, OS-128).
This is the visualisation-only stage: it publishes the boundary voxels so the detector can be validated in RViz before being wired into a controller.
